avr-notecpp.comment: Style 1: typed API groups via Api<UnstructuredCtx, StaticNotecard<SerialStack>>. The most common StaticNotecard usage. Builds with NOTE_NO_RESPONSE_RAII=1 since AVR uses arena allocation and the per-Response interned-string cleanup is a no-op for arena users; without the flag the build is ~27.9 KB (the Phase 1 RAII destructor code is unreachable but the linker can't prove it on AVR).

avr-notecpp-direct.comment: Style 2: nc.execute(req) bypassing the Api groups. Drops a layer of group thunks. Same NOTE_NO_RESPONSE_RAII=1 carve-out as avr-notecpp.

avr-notecpp-raw.comment: Style 3: transact_dispatch(RequestSource, ...) raw entry — bypasses StaticNotecard entirely, doesn't materialise Response objects, so NOTE_NO_RESPONSE_RAII makes no difference. Grew from 21,172 during the transport refactor (BuildFn → RequestSource API change).

avr-notecpp-multistack.comment: Stack-type comparison build: NOTECPP_MULTISTACK_USE picks one stack (A=HardwareSerial default, B=mock); only the selected stack's Notecard, arena, and Api instances are linked. Reflects what a real single-Notecard app pays for each stack configuration. AB instantiates both for host-side codegen-sharing measurements and overflows AVR flash.
